findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "web-technology" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web-technology_js-library-vuln-detect, web-technology_cookie-inventory-classify · Private data: web-technology_ads-txt-validate, web-technology_security-txt-validate, web-technology_cookie-inventory-classify · Public sink: web-technology_technology-detect, web-technology_js-library-vuln-detect, web-technology_analytics-tag-inventory, web-technology_ecommerce-platform-detect, web-technology_payment-provider-detect, web-technology_tech-stack-diff, web-technology_tcf-consent-string-decode, web-technology_ads-txt-validate, web-technology_security-txt-validate, web-technology_web-manifest-audit, web-technology_favicon-hash, web-technology_user-agent-parse, web-technology_crawler-identify, web-technology_cookie-inventory-classify · Destructive: web-technology_technology-detect, web-technology_js-library-vuln-detect, web-technology_analytics-tag-inventory, web-technology_ecommerce-platform-detect, web-technology_payment-provider-detect, web-technology_tech-stack-diff, web-technology_tcf-consent-string-decode, web-technology_ads-txt-validate, web-technology_security-txt-validate, web-technology_web-manifest-audit, web-technology_favicon-hash, web-technology_user-agent-parse, web-technology_crawler-identify, web-technology_cookie-inventory-classify.
